STUMP is a uterine smooth-muscle category of uncertain malignancy, conflicting site and lineage versus tubal AMFB.
Angioleiomyoma is a related vascular smooth-muscle tumor but is a distinct entity from angiomyofibroblastoma.
Leiomyoma of the tube is the main mesenchymal differential and a conflicting histologic type versus AMFB.

Angiomyofibroblastoma of the fallopian tube is the same diagnostic object as tubal angiomyofibroblastoma.
